title: Beetle Alchemist and Eden Tree
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene shows a large anthropomorphic beetle creature in a blood-stained beige coat holding a revolver in one hand and a bloody heart in the other. In the sky above, a glowing winged angelic figure with a halo hovers near a massive circular frame containing a golden-leafed tree with roots extending into dark swirling waters below.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy painting featuring a giant anthropomorphic beetle in a tattered beige coat and goggles, holding a revolver and a dripping human heart. In the background, a radiant blue-winged angel with a halo floats near a massive circular stone frame containing a mystical golden-leafed tree with gnarled roots. Cracked yellow moon, ruined stone arches, skulls, dark swirling water with skulls, purple night sky, highly detailed, atmospheric lighting.
